notes.title: Endless & Curated Mode errors fixed
notes.notes:
[p]We were seeing reports of players not being able to access the Curated levels beyond the 2nd level, plus that the Endless mode was not working.

We're delighted to report that our 3rd party partners Anything.World have tracked down and fixed the error in their tech and the game now works 100% as intended, without any need for an update.

Just boot it up and play!

We're incredibly sorry for the inconvenience and frustration this caused, please enjoy the game now that tit works as intended 💖[/p]

notes.title: Rebranded - get your chops around Picture Everything: Puzzle Cross Galaxy!
notes.notes:
We've rebranded and fixed some bugs, plus changed a couple of levels.

Please understand if your progress is wiped, we've had to change a chunk of stuff.

notes.title: Winter Sale & New Game!
notes.notes:
We've discounted the game for the Steam Winter Sale, please do leave a review if you enjoy it!

And meanwhile, we recently announced our brand new game [b]Trash Goblin[/b] - there's a free demo and tons of exciting info on this [i]cosy shopkeeping RPG[/i] over on its page.
